project_info.theme: YSL holiday advent calendar luxury gift box
project_info.color_palette: White, champagne gold, black, soft candlelight amber

main_subject.detail: An open YSL holiday advent calendar or gift chest with multiple numbered gold-and-white doors and assorted YSL beauty products arranged across two levels. The box interior features a large gold star with the YSL monogram. Visible items include perfume miniatures, a lipstick, a black tube, skincare bottles, an open eyeshadow palette, and a black candle at the bottom right.
main_subject.style: Luxury holiday gift-box still life with elegant advent-calendar structure and warm festive opulence

items: Top Left: Open upper lid of the calendar with the gold star and YSL monogram inside
Top Right: Geometric gold wall panels creating a luxury festive environment
Bottom Left: Lower advent-drawer section with perfume bottle and skincare bottle on numbered gold panels
Bottom Right: Open eyeshadow palette, black cylindrical product, and lit black candle
Center/Background: Two-tier white-and-gold advent calendar chest with multiple beauty products displayed across numbered compartments

lighting_and_atmosphere.effect: Soft metallic shimmer, candle glow, refined reflections, premium holiday warmth

technical_specs.render_style: Photoreal luxury holiday gift still-life composite

prompt.generated_prompt_string: [COMBINED PROMPT]: High quality square luxury holiday gift still life for YSL. Centerpiece is an open white-and-gold advent calendar chest with multiple numbered panels and assorted YSL beauty products spread across two levels. Show a large gold star with the YSL monogram inside the lid, plus visible products such as perfume miniatures, a lipstick, a black tube, skincare bottles, an open eyeshadow palette, and a black candle. Background is a geometric champagne-gold luxury set. Technical style: photoreal luxury holiday gift still-life composite, warm festive luxury lighting, metallic shimmer and candlelit premium warmth, 8k resolution, highly detailed.
prompt.negative_prompt: dark, gloomy, blurry, flat 2d, low resolution, distorted text, messy typography, muted colors, black and white, ugly, deformed shapes, watermark, signature, cropped
